about: REAL frames recorded by DIRECTOR-2 (offline, $0): M0-M5 against Director !605 (seat2/director-p4-7-template-match, head 81f321e3; M0-M4 at its parent 01e6903c), and M1-s11 / M3-s11 against Director !606 (seat2/director-p4-7b-s11, e10eb358, stacked on !605: COMPOSER-2's section 11 passed through: deck[].covered / total / slides and slides[].applied_match), from streams/director2/p4-7-template-match/out/. Extracted mechanically, nothing edited: every frame of direction 'in' (what Studio sends to Director) and every Director frame of type 'template_match', in recorded order, verbatim. Ids and timestamps are masked by the recorder. The proof (scripts/test-studio-template-match.mjs) compares this file with the originals when they are on disk. P4-7c (Director !611, branch seat2/director-p4-7c-matcher-v2, head ab236ac0c494, stacked on !607): M6 and M7 (scenario-M6-assignment.json, scenario-M7-mixed.json) extracted the same way, from p47c/record.py: the plan-card frame (scope deck: deck decision only, slides[] empty, no assignment) and the strawman frame (slides[], deck[i].slides and assignment[], Composer's mix-and-match plan). readme_p47c_sha256 is the README.md of that folder when M6 / M7 were extracted (readme_sha256 above is M0-M5's, from before the v2 section was appended).
